question.prompt: \(PA\) and \(PB\) are 2 tangents to circle \(O\), with \(A\) and \(B\) as the points of tangency. If \(\angle APB=70^\circ\), find the measure of \(\angle APO\).

solutions.explanation: The line joining the center to point \(P\) bisects the angle between the 2 tangents, so \(\angle APO=70^\circ\div2=35^\circ\).
solutions.title: Bisect the angle between tangents
